■ Stage Direction
Gender: Female
Age: 20s
Personality: Cheerful, hot-blooded
(Murmuring...)

...Gasp!! Don't tell me
you got cheered up by the ants too?!

Huh? ...AAAHHHHHHHHH--?!
No way, is it that late already?! Thanks for telling me, Taishin...!!

Ticket-san! It's a shame about the result, but...
I think it was a fantastic run! Great work out there!

YYEEESSSSSSSSSS--!!
Let's definitely win together--

Here comes Winning Ticket!! She's steadily picking
up speed!! Showing off her magnificent legs!!
The Japanese Derby, that is!!

This was the morning of the Debut Selection Race,
where Umamusume show off their abilities to scouts...

Seriously... *sniff*... Y-Your friendship has...
touched me sooo deeeeeplyyyy--!!

That's right!
Ants are amazing!!

The ants cheered me up, and I even met a friend
who gets energized by ants too--
Then is this really the time to be standing around staring at ants?!

Th-The Derby? Ticket-san,
you want to become a "Derby Umamusume"?

Aaaagh, no one scouted me...
So frustraaaaaaating--!!

Selling oil? I'm not selling any oil!!
Wait, Taishin, are you making tempura or something?!

Despite Winning Ticket's desperate attempts to stop them,
the trainer walked away.

WAAAAAAHHHHHH--!!
I'm so moved--!!

I know, I totally get it! Watching someone try their hardest fills you with courage!
With emotion! With energy, right?!!

"Take the Derby." The way she earnestly repeated those words
left a surprisingly deep impression on me...

Rounding the fourth corner into the final straight!
Winning Ticket is falling back! She can't find that extra gear!

Among the conversations, the Umamusume from earlier,
Winning Ticket, was also brought up, but—

Though you could say she's a bit too optimistic. Her determination
to give it her all is admirable, but heart alone won't win races.

...But I won't get discouraged! I won't give up!
Someday, I'm definitely gonna--

Oooofffff course!
That's why I came to Tracen Academy in the first place!
DORYAAAHHHH--!!

Ah! Taishin!! It's Taishin!!
Good moooorning~~!! So happy to see you, Taishiiin!

...I-I'm sorry. If it were a sprint, perhaps, but I lack the ability
to lead you to a Derby victory... I truly am sorry.

Same here! I've got an important race today,
and now I feel like I can give it everything I've got!

...For now, I decided to head
toward the selection race venue as well.

I mean... not that it's any of my business, but
do you really have time to be idling around here?

Ticket's running in the turf 1200m! I just love
the way she runs~. She's always giving it her all with such a positive attitude!

You're tryin'... *sniff*... soo haaard...!
UWAAAAAAHHHHHH--!!

Until the day I take the Derby,
it's a full throttle DAAAAAASH!!

WHAAAAT?! T-Th... Thaaaank yoooouuu!!
Wait, are you scouting me?! Is this a scout?!

Gah! Wait, wait, I'm coming too!
See ya, fellow ant buddy! Hope we run into each other again somewhere!!

WOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!
That is... THAT IS SO INCREDIBLEEEE!!!!
Right after I said something, too... Ow, my ears hurt.

I'm so hapPEEEEEE!!
YAHOOOOOOOOO!!

Whoa, everyone's running with so much spirit...!
Allllrrriiiight, I gotta give it everything I've got, too!!

It was a metaphor, dummy! That's not what I meant—
you're running in today's Debut Selection race too, right?!

When did this become about friendship?! When?!
Ugh, seriously, what a weirdo...
...But I won't get discouraged!! I won't give up!!
(I seem to have become her "buddy" somewhere along the way...)

..."Winning Ticket in the Derby?"
Murmurs expressing that exact sentiment instantly filled the air.

As a result, despite an impressive early burst, she failed to pace herself
according to the flow of the race, crossing the finish line in 5th place...

Nnngh... Uuuugh......
G-Gave it... everythiiing...!
...Her initial momentum was undeniably impressive, but that was as far as it went.

GUUUUUUUUUUUH!!
I'M SO FRUUUUUSTRAAATED!!
MISTER AAAAAAANT...!!

...Could you give it a rest first thing in the morning?
Your loud voice is making my head throb.

—The lead pack passes the 600m mark!
The pace is looking rather brisk!

Trainers seeking fateful encounters with talented Umamusume had already
gathered in large numbers, chatting about today's contenders.

The grit to never give up and keep marching forward step by step along that long road!
The courage to carry a heavy load without ever faltering, even with such a tiny body!!

And so came the Debut Selection race,
where Winning Ticket's performance turned out to be—
